title: Portable Pipelines release intent
description: Committed machine-readable intent for one release. GitHub Actions reads this file from the merge commit. Pull request titles and bodies are ignored.

schema_version.description: Intent format version. Must be the integer 1.

publish.description: When true, merging this file onto master is a request to publish. When false, Actions only validates the file.

version.description: Workspace version without a leading v. Must match Cargo.toml.

tag.description: Git tag to create. Must be the letter v followed by version.

notes_file.description: Path of the reviewed notes that become the GitHub Release body.
